lines: Dr L. Vijayashree is an accomplished academic leader, innovation strategist and entrepreneurship mentor with over nineteen years of academic experience, including three years as Head and Professor of MBA and four years in industry. She blends institutional leadership with a strong commitment to research, intellectual property creation, and start-up incubation. A certified Harvard Design Thinker, she has delivered numerous invited talks, mentored entrepreneurs, and secured multi-crore grants for student-led innovation projects across India.
